description: This file provides utility functions for managing '.roo' configuration directories, including locating global and project-specific directories, checking existence of files/directories, reading configuration files, discovering subfolder '.roo' directories, and loading/merging configuration content. It is central to handling project configuration paths and content management.

methods.name: getGlobalRooDirectory
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the global '.roo' directory based on the user's home directory.

methods.name: getProjectRooDirectoryForCwd
methods.description: Determines the project-local '.roo' directory path for a given current working directory, preferring '.roo' if it exists and '.kilocode' otherwise.

methods.name: directoryExists
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: readFileIfExists
methods.description: Reads a file's content if it exists; returns null if the file does not exist.

methods.name: discoverSubfolderRooDirectories
methods.description: Uses ripgrep to find all '.roo' directories within subdirectories of the given workspace root.

methods.name: getRooDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of directories to check, starting with global, then project-local.

methods.name: getAllRooDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of all '.roo' directories including subfolders, global first, then project-local, then nested subfolders.

methods.name: getAgentsDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns parent directories containing '.roo' folders or 'AGENTS.md', from root to subfolders.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and merges configuration files from global and project-specific '.roo' directories, with project overriding global.
